_source: Final_Diploma_Rule_One_Pager.pdf (Blueprint for Success: Readiness Seals) + 1_16_25 Memo (Enrollment Honors Seal course eligibility section) + Updated_New_Indiana_Diploma_FAQ.pdf
_note: This file references 'flexible_category_tags' and 'diploma_requirement_id' values that were attached to individual courses across all department files. It does NOT duplicate course data - it defines the combination rules that get evaluated against whichever courses/credits/scores a student has.
general_rules: Students may earn one or multiple seals - they are not mutually exclusive.
Earning ANY seal satisfies Graduation Pathways requirements automatically. Students who earn NO seal must still complete Graduation Pathways components 2 and 3 separately.
Diploma (base) requirements CAN simultaneously count toward seal requirements - this is the one exception to the one-credit-one-requirement rule (confirmed FAQ Q42).

Work-based learning (WBL) hours roll into each other across seals (confirmed FAQ Q45): a student earning 650 total WBL hours (max 3 distinct experiences) simultaneously satisfies the WBL portion of Enrollment Honors Plus (75 hrs), Employment Honors (150 hrs), and Employment Honors Plus (650 hrs total).

Several inputs here CANNOT be derived from course selection alone and must be self-reported/manually entered by the student: cumulative GPA, SAT/ACT/ASVAB scores, attendance record, WBL hours completed, and 'skill development' verification. The Four-Year Builder needs a manual-entry section for these, separate from automatic course-tracking.

requirements.rule: At least 6 Social Studies credits. Base requirements (US History 2 + US Govt 1 + World Perspectives 2 = 5) count toward this, PLUS 1 more credit from courses tagged seal.enrollment_honors_ss_sixth_credit. IMPORTANT: World Language Level III-VI credits used for the base World Perspectives requirement CANNOT also be used for this 6th credit.

At least 8 Math credits: Algebra I (2) + Personal Finance (1) + Geometry (2) = 5 credits minimum baseline, PLUS EITHER [Algebra II (2) + 2 credits tagged seal.enrollment_honors_advanced_math] OR [4 credits tagged seal.enrollment_honors_advanced_math].

At least 6 Science credits: Biology I (2) required, PLUS Chemistry - a course tagged seal.enrollment_honors_chemistry_required (2 credits), PLUS EITHER a course tagged seal.enrollment_honors_physics_option OR 2 credits tagged lab_science from the seal.enrollment_honors_advanced_lab_science_option list. Note: ICP (Integrated Chemistry-Physics) does NOT satisfy the Chemistry-specific requirement, only the Advanced Lab Science option.
C or higher in ALL courses AND a cumulative B average or higher - self-reported/manually tracked, not derivable from course selection.
Complete ONE of the following (manually entered/self-reported):
options: Earn 4 credits in AP, IB, or Cambridge courses AND take the corresponding exams
Earn 6 college credits (via dual credit)
Score 1250+ on SAT OR 26+ on ACT
Earn TWO of the following: at least 3 college credits; 2 AP credits + exams; 2 IB credits + exams; 2 Cambridge credits + exams

additional_requirements.rule: Earn an eligible market-driven Credential of Value (see Credentials of Value list). Examples given: Associate degree, Technical Certificate, Indiana College Core, AP Scholar with Distinction, Cambridge AICE Diploma, IB Diploma.
Complete at least 75 hours of work-based learning (may combine up to 3 experiences; paid, unpaid, on-site, or simulated).
Demonstrate skill development in Communication, Collaboration, and Work Ethic (verified via a form/rubric per district process - see FAQ Q36).

enrollment_honors_plus.benefit_note: Per Senate Enrolled Act 448-2025, graduating with this seal grants automatic admission to all Indiana public state institutions, and some private institutions opt in as well.

options: A market-driven credential of value aligned to a specific occupation (see Credentials of Value list)
3 courses within a single CTE pathway (tagged cte_pathway.* - all 3 must share the same pathway tag)
An approved career preparation experience aligned to Indiana's CSA program
An approved, locally-created pathway

requirements.rule: Complete 150 hours of work-based learning (up to 3 experiences; paid, unpaid, on-site, or simulated). Courses tagged seal.employment_honors_wbl_hours_source (Work Based Learning Capstone, Cooperative Education) are common sources but not the only ones.
Demonstrate skill development in Communication, Collaboration, and Work Ethic.

options: At least 1 school year with no more than 3 unexcused absences
At least 150 hours of WBL experience with no more than 3 unexcused absences during that time

additional_requirements.rule: Earn a market-driven Credential of Value (Associate degree, Technical Certificate, Indiana College Core, or an industry certification).

Complete additional WBL for a TOTAL of 650 hours across one or more experiences (max 3 distinct experiences) - this total includes hours already counted toward Employment Honors' 150-hour requirement.
Demonstrate skill development in Communication, Collaboration, Work Ethic, plus any additional skills determined locally by the school.

options: Introduction to Public Service course (state-preferred course, code 3524) or an approved locally-created equivalent, with emphasis on physical standards/character required for service
One year of JROTC or Civil Air Patrol in high school

requirements.rule: Achieve a score of 31+ on the ASVAB AND complete ONE of the following (manually entered/self-reported):
options: All three components of the Career Exploration Program
A career exploration tool approved by IDOE

requirements.rule: At least 1 school year with no more than 3 unexcused absences.

Demonstrate skill development in Communication, Collaboration, and Work Ethic, externally verified through a mentorship experience with current military personnel, veterans, or other public safety professionals.

options: Achieve a score of 50+ on the ASVAB
Enrollment in ROTC at the collegiate level
Acceptance to a service academy

additional_requirements.rule: Demonstrate excellence in leadership through ONE of the following:
options: Completion of at least 100 hours of public service
Holding a leadership role in a co-curricular or extracurricular activity
Completion of two seasons of a team-based physical sport or activity

credentials_of_value._note: Full scored list lives in 20262027_Credentials_of_Value_List__FULL_COV_List.pdf in the project - hundreds of entries, each with a 'Final COV Score' from issuing institutions like Ivy Tech, Vincennes University, and various certification bodies. This rules file does NOT duplicate that list; the site should query it directly (or a converted version of it) when checking a specific certification against seal requirements, rather than this file trying to re-embed hundreds of rows.
